description: Read one numbered part of a published MFM document or dataset (an id returned by search that starts with "portfolio:" recomputes the portfolio calculator, nothing stored). Company metadata includes verification_level, audit_id, audit_url and controls_performed. metadata.next_id identifies the following part or is null. Audit levels describe programme membership. Company records: amounts are whole units of the currency stated in each period (field currency), never thousands or millions; ratios in metrics are decimals (0.15 = 15%) except anni_* (years), copertura_interessi, conversione_utili_cassa, investimenti_su_ammortamenti and debito_su_patrimonio* (multiples, 1.5 = 1.5 times). years are in ascending order: the latest fiscal year is the LAST element, in the last parts, so follow every next_id before answering. ttm, quarters and interim_reports are separate periods with their own end dates; infrannuale_piu_recente names the most recent interim period and the block that holds it: use that one and never annualise. A null metric has its reason in warnings of the same period; an absent key is not zero. The pe block holds the P/E shown on the site, with the month-end price, its date and currency, earnings per share and the method (pe_ultimo null = not computed, reason in motivo_en); other price-based figures (market value, dividend yield) are not in the record. public_float is the aggregate market value of shares held by non-affiliates declared on the cover of the annual report (SEC: at the end of the second fiscal quarter), not the current market capitalisation; public_float_info gives its date, filing and definition. Two rows with the same fiscal_year (change of year-end) are told apart by period_label. When scheda_conservata_en (Italian: scheda_conservata) is present, the record is retained and no longer updated by the computation: state since when, why and the last financial year before using its figures. A period with perimetro_diverso belongs, wholly or for the listed items (voci), to a different entity (shell, SPAC, reverse-merger predecessor, divested scope): say so, use its en text and do not compare it with later periods. Descriptive data only: no forecast, no recommendation.
